# Marlow Health Systems — Independent assurance standard

Version 1.0. Effective 1 September 2026.

This standard defines the three supplier obligations reviewed for the named service. Descriptions of internal filing and contacts do not create additional supplier duties. Evidence is assessed as of 17 September 2026; an exception applies only where its conditions are documented.

## 1. Independent review report

For a high-criticality service, the supplier must provide a report issued by an assessor independent of the supplier within the previous 12 months. The report must cover the contracted production service; a supplier self-declaration is insufficient.

## 2. Finding treatment

Every unresolved high-severity finding in the supplied independent report must have a named owner, corrective action and target completion date documented by the supplier.

## 3. Control monitoring

The supplier must monitor the contracted service controls at least monthly and retain a record of each review, including months with no detected issue.

# Briarfield Cloud — Service assurance packet

Statement date: 17 September 2026. Scope: the contracted customer service described below.

We state that our controls meet industry expectations and that an external assessor has reviewed us. No assessor report or extract accompanies this packet, so the issuer, report date, scope and any findings cannot be established from the supplied material.

The service owner reviews contracted-service controls every month and retains a signed review record even when the review finds no issue.

### Briarfield Cloud administrative register 001: capacity planning

Record S09-OP-101 describes the capacity planning workstream for the hosted business service. The service directory associates this workstream with internal team 1 and release cohort 1. A coordinator compares the open work list with the preceding release summary and records items awaiting another team. The directory distinguishes a production service identifier from a training-workspace identifier; labels in screenshots are illustrative and do not expand contractual scope. This entry records 2 unresolved administrative items and 3 closed items, with a reference to meeting note S09-MN-201. Scheduling information supports delivery planning and is not evidence of security approval. The appended worksheet describes ordinary service administration; it makes no statement about backup encryption, customer authorization for data exports or export-record retention. The next register entry covers release scheduling, with separate owners and work references.

# Wintermere Systems — Service assurance packet

Statement date: 17 September 2026. Scope: the contracted customer service described below.

For unresolved finding H-17, the corrective-action register names Priya Shah as owner, specifies a restoration test including encrypted backups, and sets completion for 30 September 2026.

The service owner reviews controls monthly, but records are saved only when an issue is detected. Records for months without issues are intentionally not retained.

# Independent assurance report extract

Issued 15 July 2026 by Westbridge Assurance, an assessor organizationally independent of the supplier. Scope: the contracted production service for Marlow. Finding H-17 is high severity and unresolved as of the statement date: restoration tests did not include encrypted backups.

expected_assessments.rationale: The independent supplied report is recent and explicitly covers the contracted production service.
